text: Managing a team is a challenging but rewarding responsibility. Good communication is the foundation of success, so leaders should share clear goals and listen to their team members. Delegation is also important; trusting people with tasks helps them grow and prevents the leader from becoming overloaded. Regular feedback, both positive and negative, keeps everyone on track and shows that their work matters. Motivation comes from recognising achievements and creating a supportive atmosphere. Finally, when disagreements arise, a good leader deals with them calmly and fairly, finding solutions that satisfy everyone. By combining these skills, managers can build a strong, happy and productive team.
